narrative.text: Merchant MID100047 declared digital_services at onboarding 422 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the digital_services baseline are slope_log_volume at +4.6 sigma (observed 0.0115 against a category baseline of 0.00251), night_share at +3.3 sigma (observed 0.379 against a category baseline of 0.171), velocity_drift at +2.4 sigma (observed 0.15 against a category baseline of 0.00222). The homepage surface presents a sports_betting interface at 0.95 confidence, against a declared category of digital_services. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. In total 2 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 2 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier restricts settlements, corroborated by the telemetry channel; the storefront alone would not have been sufficient.
